exposure.needed: whether the operator runs pilot-agent istio-clean-iptables on pods whose iptables contain the ISTIO_OUTPUT chain (live pod network-namespace state and operator action, not static configuration)

consequence.statement: Running `pilot-agent istio-clean-iptables` now removes the ISTIO_OUTPUT iptables chain that the command previously left behind, so pods cleaned with the command get a complete rule cleanup instead of a partial one.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; if you use istio-clean-iptables to strip intercept rules, re-run it and verify the ISTIO_OUTPUT chain is gone.

assertion.statement: In Istio 1.24.0, running `pilot-agent istio-clean-iptables` now also removes the `ISTIO_OUTPUT` iptables chain, which the command previously failed to remove.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for cli-flag behavior-changed
